Name: Boggified Coop and Barn Interiors
Author: geekyraven
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Completely boggified coop and barn interiors! Perfect for anyone who has been using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch's[/url] coop and barn recolors and want interiors to match.
The sprites for the feed hopper, incubator, ostrich incubator, and hay have been recolored to match the tilesheets used. Each of these recolors is able to be toggled on/off via the config file (or menu if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed). All are toggled on by default.

I am currently in the process of making a recolor of the premium coop and premium barn from Stardew Valley Expanded, and will include it as an optional download once it is finished.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43167]BogWyytch's Tilesheets[/url] are required. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url] is used in the screenshots and is highly recommended, but not required. The dirt color in the screenshots is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor[/url], set to purple.[/color]

[size=4][b]Config Options[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]To enable or disable the recolors of the coop and barn objects, set each to either true or false.[/color]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
I obtained permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods]BogWyytch[/url] to use the term "boggified" and the BogWyytch color palette. Her mods are amazing, go check them out! Shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url] for their guidance and help with troubleshooting, they helped make publishing this mod possible :)
